summary: Living space is tidy but tight clearances and loose rug perimeters present minor trip hazards.

hazards.title: Low clearance around coffee table
hazards.detail: Narrow walkway between low table and seating risks stumbles or bruised shins.
fixSteps: Ensure at least 18 inches of clearance between seating and table.
Reposition armchairs slightly outward to widen walking path.

hazards.title: Potential rug edge curl
hazards.detail: Area rug edges sit directly under high-traffic walking paths without visible anchoring.
fixSteps: Apply rug gripper tape along edges to prevent curling.
Ensure a non-slip pad covers the entire underside.

products.name: Non-Slip Rug Tape Grippers
products.reason: Anchors rug edges flat to floor to prevent tripping.
